name: City of Palm Coast Special Events
controls: Pink Army 5K and other city special events
relationship: Prior outreach exists. Treat the annual vendor packet as reusable groundwork, but confirm each date and category opening.
ask: Which upcoming events still need a frozen dessert truck, what is the total vendor cost, and is the annual packet complete?

name: Flagler County Cultural Council
relationship: Published food-truck application exists. Danielle Anderson is a useful recurring contact.
ask: How many frozen-dessert vendors are accepted, is a full-length truck space available, and what future events use the same vendor pool?

name: Flagler Broadcasting
relationship: Multiple event routes under one organizer make this contact more valuable than a single event.
ask: Request the current food-truck contract, all-in fee, dessert roster, recent gate count, placement, mandatory hours and weather terms.

name: Florida Agricultural Museum
controls: Food Truck Friday on the Farm
relationship: Recurring monthly format. One good test date can become repeat work.
ask: Ask Kara for the next dessert opening, current truck fee, dessert categories already booked and rain-credit policy.

name: SMART Flagler
relationship: Public vendor request makes this a concrete lead rather than a generic calendar listing.
ask: Confirm the dessert-truck opening, total vendor fee, competition and any required giveback.

name: Flagler Schools / PTO / Athletics
relationship: School opportunities are relationship-driven and require campus or concessions approval, not just an event listing.
ask: Ask for the PTO event chair or athletic concessions decision-maker and offer one easy trial or prepaid treat event.

name: ArtiSUN Markets
relationship: One registration system controls multiple dates and venues. Historical/current pricing has differed by event.
ask: Confirm food-truck category availability for each date, frozen-dessert competition and whether repeat vendors receive priority.

name: Hastings Main Street, Inc.
relationship: One organizer controls both a fall festival and the spring Cabbage, Potato & Bacon Festival. Historical food-truck applications show concrete fees and generator rules.
ask: Ask when the next food-truck application opens, whether frozen desserts are available, and whether one successful date helps with future festivals.

name: St. Augustine Lions Foundation
relationship: Established recurring festival with a dedicated food and beverage vendor inquiry route.
ask: Request the 2027 food-and-beverage packet, fee, vendor count, dessert overlap and latest actual attendance figure.

name: Grand Haven / Vesta Property Services
relationship: Best approached as a host-promoted private social, not rent-only parking.
ask: Pitch a 90-minute prepaid or minimum-guarantee ice cream social with one clear invoice.

name: St. Johns County Parks Foundation
relationship: The foundation explicitly advertises vendor and sponsorship opportunities around family recreation events.
ask: Request the current vendor/partner packet, exact fee, finish-area placement, included refreshments and whether dessert is still open.
